guideModules.title: Purification
steps: Purify the eligible Shadow Pokémon. The National Ribbon records that purification.
cautions: Only Pokémon originally obtainable as Shadow Pokémon qualify; do not add this to an ordinary Pokémon.
XD NSO release-specific behavior still needs a separate check.

guideModules.title: Mt. Battle
steps: Complete all 100 Mt. Battle trainers in one uninterrupted challenge with the Pokémon in the party.
Use the story-mode challenge in Colosseum. Keep the same party throughout the run.
cautions: Do not leave the challenge or change party members.
XD NSO needs a release-specific confirmation before publishing its guide.

guideModules.title: Hoenn contests
steps: Work through Normal, Super, Hyper and Master in each of the five contest categories.
Plan Pokéblocks before feeding: condition and Sheen carry forward. Pick moves and combinations valid for this species in this game.
cautions: These 20 legacy awards contribute to Contest Memory after transfer.
Do not reuse ORAS or Sinnoh move-combo advice here.

guideModules.title: Artist Ribbon
steps: Speak to the Lilycove Museum director to enable the painting request.
Win a sufficiently high-scoring Master Rank contest and accept the artist’s painting.
cautions: Exact score threshold needs a further check before putting a number in the app.
pending: Exact score threshold and score definition.

guideModules.title: Hoenn Battle Tower
steps: Winning: reach 56 consecutive wins in the Level 50 challenge.
Victory: reach 56 wins in Ruby/Sapphire Level 100 or Emerald Open Level.
Bring the Ribbon Master for the final seven-battle set, battles 50–56.
cautions: Earn Winning before leveling past 50; these games do not scale a higher-level Pokémon down.
Emerald Open Level opponents are at least level 60. Check facility species/item clauses.

guideModules.title: Sinnoh Super Contests
steps: Complete Normal, Great, Ultra and Master in each category.
Prepare condition with Poffins, collect accessories and scarves, then handle Visual, Dance and Acting rounds.
cautions: Sheen limits feeding. Gen III contest combinations do not apply to these Acting rounds.

guideModules.title: Sinnoh and Johto Battle Tower
steps: Ability: defeat Palmer at battle 21; Great Ability: defeat him at 49 in Singles.
Double Ability: win battle 50 in Doubles. Multi Ability: win battle 50 with an NPC partner.
Pair Ability: win battle 50 with a human link partner. World Ability: reach Wi-Fi Rank 5.
cautions: The official Nintendo Wi-Fi service has ended; World Ability is an optional historical/unofficial-service branch.
D/P and Platinum/HGSS use different opponent pools. Check which game hosts the linked battle.
A Singles team is not a substitute for an NPC or human Multi team.

guideModules.title: Battle Maison
steps: Defeat a Battle Chatelaine at battle 20 in a normal format for Skillful Battler.
Defeat a Chatelaine at battle 50 in a Super format for Expert Battler.
Only one format is needed per ribbon; review the selected format’s team and item restrictions.
cautions: The ribbon recipient must participate in the awarding battle. Teams can be changed between individual battles here.
Do not apply the Gen III seven-battle entry rule to the Maison.

guideModules.title: Hoenn Contest Spectaculars
steps: Win Master Rank in each of the five categories for its Master ribbon.
Win all five with the same Pokémon for Contest Star.
Build condition with Pokéblocks and choose a species-compatible contest moveset.
cautions: ORAS has no old Sheen feeding cap. Its combinations and awards differ from RSE.

guideModules.title: Battle Tree
steps: Win battle 20 of a normal challenge for Battle Tree Great.
Win battle 50 of a Super challenge for Battle Tree Master.
cautions: USUM normal challenges allow restricted Pokémon that SM normal challenges do not.
The USUM normal exception does not apply to Super formats.

guideModules.title: Battle Royal
steps: Unlock the higher ranks and win a Master Rank Battle Royal with the Pokémon on the entered team.
Plan around the scoring and the round ending when one trainer loses all three Pokémon.
cautions: A strong lead can support the other slots, but no method is a guaranteed win.

guideModules.title: Galar Battle Tower
steps: Climb the Battle Tower to Master Ball tier.
Defeat Leon at Master Ball tier with your own Pokémon entered.
cautions: An ordinary win after reaching the tier is not the Leon requirement.
Rental teams can help climb; a rented Pokémon cannot receive a ribbon for your own Pokémon.

guideModules.title: Sinnoh remakes Battle Tower
steps: Unlock Master Class by completing the normal Tower requirement.
Climb Master Class and defeat Palmer at Rank 10 with the ribbon recipient entered.
cautions: This is the same Tower Master Ribbon as Sword/Shield, with a different challenge.
Full unlock/rank progression and recipient timing need the final editorial pass.

guideModules.title: Sinnoh Super Contest Shows
steps: Win Star of the Show at Master Rank in each standard category for its Master ribbon.
Complete all five for Contest Star, then win the Master Rank Brilliant/Shining contest for Twinkling Star.
Prepare condition, Ball Capsule stickers and a contest move; practice the rhythm sequence.
cautions: Twinkling Star requires Master Rank, not just any Brilliant/Shining rank.
The Poffin feeding/Sheen constraints differ from ORAS Pokéblocks.

guideModules.title: Master Rank Ribbon
steps: Win at Master Ball tier with your own registered Battle Team. The ribbon applies to eligible Pokémon on that team, including those not selected at Team Preview.
Check that game’s active regulation before selecting a build or replacement slot.
cautions: A rental can help climb but cannot award the ribbon to your own Pokémon.
Regulations, service availability and rental codes need dated reviews.
Pokémon Champions titles must not be presented as a portable Master Rank Ribbon.

currentReview.sv: Season 41: Regulation I from 2026-04-01 04:00 UTC until service ends, per official announcement.
currentReview.swsh: Series 14 reference checked; seek an official service/rule confirmation before claiming indefinite current availability.

guideModules.title: Hisui photo studio
steps: Prepare the Pokémon for a photo at the Jubilife Village photography studio.
cautions: Actually taking the picture is not required. The ribbon is invisible in Legends: Arceus; later compatible software displays it.

guideModules.title: Legacy ribbon consolidation
steps: Treat Memory Ribbons as the transferred record of Gen III/IV contest and battle awards.
Keep the original earned awards in the passport history while displaying the consolidated result for later games.
cautions: These are not new contest/Tower tasks to complete in Gen VI.
Maison, Tree and newer battle ribbons stay separate. Gold appearance/thresholds vary with software version and need an explicit version table.
pending: Check Gen VII display bugs and exact version behavior before using these thresholds for artwork; do not alter stored history based on display.

guideModules.title: Weekday ribbons
steps: Speak to the correct NPC on the matching weekday with the intended Pokémon selected.
Monday Alert; Tuesday Shock; Wednesday Downcast; Thursday Careless; Friday Relax; Saturday Snooze; Sunday Smile.
cautions: Check the game’s location and any first-meeting prerequisite. Do not show a generic location for every generation.

locations.x y: Hotel circuit: Ambrette Mon, Camphrier Tue, Geosenge Wed, Coumarine Thu, Couriway Fri, Cyllage Sat, Coumarine Sun

guideModules.title: Ribbon purchases
steps: Purchase Gorgeous for ₽10,000, Royal for ₽100,000, then Gorgeous Royal for ₽999,999 for the selected Pokémon.
cautions: Check the local access requirement and purchase order.

guideModules.title: Effort Ribbon
steps: Finish the Pokémon’s EV training (510 total effort values), then speak to the Effort Ribbon NPC.

guideModules.title: Best Friends Ribbon
steps: Build the required relationship value, then visit the game’s ribbon NPC.
XY/ORAS use Pokémon-Amie affection; Alola uses Pokémon Refresh affection. Later games use friendship.
cautions: Affection and friendship must not be treated as the same counter in Gen VI/VII.
Verify the exact NPC and threshold for each version before release.
pending: Confirm exact NPC details and numerical friendship/affection thresholds in final editorial pass.

guideModules.title: Footprint Ribbon
steps: D/P/Pt: show Dr. Footstep a Pokémon with the required friendship.
XY/ORAS/Alola: raise it at least 30 levels above its recorded met-level baseline, then visit the ribbon NPC.
BDSP: normally use the 30-level rule; voiceless Pokémon use the friendship exception.
cautions: Check transfer changes to the recorded met level, particularly Gen V migration.
The last-chance decision must use the Pokémon’s actual baseline, level cap and reachable later games.
pending: Cross-check numerical friendship threshold and transferred met-level baselines before implementation; exception list is source-recorded but not playtested.

guideModules.title: Training Ribbon
steps: Earn gold medals in all 30 Super Training courses, including the Secret courses, with this Pokémon.
Visit the ribbon NPC after completing the course list.
cautions: Training bags alone are not course completion.

guideModules.title: League and champion ribbons
steps: Complete the appropriate champion battle with the Pokémon in the qualifying party.
cautions: The Gen III Champion Ribbon and ORAS Hoenn Champion Ribbon are distinct awards.
FR/LG Switch release details need their own verification.
Do not invent an earnable Unova Champion Ribbon; record a Gen V league victory as an optional honor.

requirements.paldea-champion-ribbon: Defeat Geeta or win the Academy Ace Tournament

guideModules.title: Marks obtainable after capture
steps: Itemfinder: collect ground items with the Pokémon using Let’s Go.
Partner: travel with the Pokémon at friendship 200 or higher; the mark is awarded by chance while walking.
Gourmand: share purchased meals or sandwiches; the mark is awarded by chance.
Jumbo/Mini: have the Mesagoza size judge inspect a Pokémon at the appropriate extreme size.
cautions: Jumbo and Mini are optional and explicitly excluded from Ribbon Master requirements.
Do not imply that catching a Pokémon without a catch-only mark can add that mark later.
Do not list Once-in-a-Lifetime as an available earning task without verified implementation evidence.
Avoid exact mark probabilities until conflicting references are resolved.
pending: Verify numerical steps/friendship thresholds from implementation evidence before publishing exact counters.

editorialRules: Community strategy is attributed advice, not an official game description.
Read a source is not equivalent to independently playtested.
Preserve published EVs/IVs and move order; record adaptations separately.
Unknown fields remain unknown. Rental codes are never marked live without checking in game.
Optional honors and size marks never count toward Ribbon Master completion.
Current Pokémon eligibility and completed legacy history are separate; do not erase earned history after transfer.
Do not infer HOME registration, individual earning games or trainer-wide honors from a Pokémon save record.
Keep notes, screenshots and personal builds in app backup/recovery; omit unsupported fields from external exports.

conflicts.decision: Do not offer as earnable. References disagree about whether granting logic exists; seek implementation-level evidence.
Use chance-after-meals wording; exact reported probabilities conflict.
Require Master Rank Brilliant/Shining; do not simplify to any rank.
Do not promise a portable Master Rank Ribbon. Track only as optional local honor until official return behavior is documented.

releaseGates: Final editorial review for every game-specific location/prerequisite.

Verify Artist score, friendship/affection thresholds, transferred Footprint baseline, Memory display bugs/version table and precise post-capture mark counters. Footprint exception species are source-recorded.
Check Switch FR/LG and XD NSO rather than assuming cartridge behavior.
Use factual builds and original summaries with attribution. Link original articles; do not bundle copied articles, author screenshots or unlicensed assets.
A dedicated RM-carry recommendation needs evidence for that replacement slot; the benchmark list alone is insufficient.
Check current online regulation/service status before shipping; no supplied rental code has been validated live.
Complete the honor catalog definitions, including what Shiny Crown means in the original suggestion.
